kinematics.architecture: SLA (Short-Long Arm) Double Wishbone Independent Front Suspension
key_parameters_demonstrated: Wheel Camber Angle vs Heave (Negative Camber Gain)
Spring Deflection and Dynamic Force (k = 45 N/mm)

implementation_details.nodes: 11 labeled 3D mechanical joints per side (N1: LCAF, N2: LCAR, N3: UCAF, N4: UCAR, N5: LBJ, N6: UBJ, N7: ITR, N8: OTR, N9: ShockTop, N10: ShockLCA, N11: WheelCenter) with interactive raycast tooltips
implementation_details.rigid_lines: Color-coded high-contrast truss skeleton for UCA (cyan), LCA (amber), knuckle upright (violet), tie rod (green), and subframe
implementation_details.deformable_lines: Dynamic parametric 3D helical coil spring (deforms physically in real time), telescopic damper rod/body, dynamic instant center projection rays
implementation_details.steering_mechanism: Chassis-mounted rack and pinion driving inner tie rods, tie rod links, and outer steering arms with Ackermann geometry
implementation_details.kingpin_trajectory: 3D spatial path ribbons recording UBJ, LBJ, and Wheel Center trajectories with auto-trace, point counter, and clear/export functions
visual_styles: 2. CAD Solid Metallic Mesh (A-arms, Knuckle, Rotor, Caliper, Rim, Tire, Subframe)
4. Kinematics Analysis (Instant Center & Roll Center Vectors)
implementation_details.ui_style: Strict industrial software aesthetic: 0px border-radius, zero box-shadow, zero emojis, technical dark theme (#0f1216), monospace font, real-time Canvas telemetry charts

dependencies.orbit_controller: Self-contained built-in CADOrbitController with inertia damping and view presets
